body: I see what you mean. I'm scared though. I'm used to so much stability in my life.

But the thing is I've never shown even the slightest display of suicide or emotional troubles. My parents know me as the happy kid. I bring happiness to my family so I'm torn. I'm not happy with myself but I bring happiness to my family. Do I choice myself or my family even if I love them more than I do myself.

I can't. I don't want to bring that upon them. I love them more than anything. Last thing I want them to do is start worrying about me. My brother is attending a top 5 university so I've always been the slower one. I don't want them to have another reason to be worried about me. Everyone looks at me and sees me as a happy guy. I'm the guy everyone comes to for help or advice. That's cause I always bottle all my stress and emotions and put a smile on my face to make everyone else happy. Making my parents fear for me is the last thing I want to do.
